title: Ya Imam e Mohammed e Baqer
body:
Ya imam e mohammed e baqer.
Apne baba ko rootey hain jaffer.
1.Kya shahadat ki Shaam aayi hai.
Kya udaasi jahan may chhayii hai.
Kehrahe hain ghulam rorokar....ya imam......
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Sar se utha imam ka saaya.
Rzeher hasham ne diya aisa.
Paara paara huwa hai qalb o jigar...ya imam.....
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Zeher se jism sard hota tha.
Raat dinn dil may dard hota tha.
Zeher se chaar dinn rahe muztar.... ya imam......
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Farma bardaar aise hote hain.
Aaj saarey uloom rootey hain.
Apne baba ko rootay hain jaffer.....ya imam....
<<DIVIDER>>
5.Qaid e zaalim may zindagi kii hai.
Qaid rehkar bhi bandagi ki hai.
Masjidoun ka udaas hai manzar.....ya imam.....
<<DIVIDER>>
6.Gham may rooti hai Fatima zahra.
Dijiye sadeqeen ko pursa.
Aapko rooye aaj paighambar.....ya imam.....
<<DIVIDER>>
7.Aaj matam bapa hai baqer ka.
Aaj dil rooraha dawar ka.
Aaj ahle haram may hai mehshar... ya imam.....
Azz:-dawar Ali dawar
